mapper.sql: application.business_application_id AS businessApplicationId, application.member_id AS memberId, member_info.name AS name, member_info.birth AS birth, member_info.phone AS phone, application.application_status AS applicationStatus, application.rejection_reason AS rejectionReason, application.applied_at AS appliedAt, application.reviewed_at AS reviewedAt, application.reviewed_by AS reviewedBy
mapper.select: select count(*) from member where member_id = #{adminMemberId} and member_type = 0 and member_role = 'ADMIN' and member_status = 'ACTIVE' and deleted_at is null

select count(*) AS totalCount, coalesce(sum( case when application_status = 'PENDING' then 1 else 0 end ), 0) AS pendingCount, coalesce(sum( case when application_status = 'APPROVED' then 1 else 0 end ), 0) AS approvedCount, coalesce(sum( case when application_status = 'REJECTED' then 1 else 0 end ), 0) AS rejectedCount from business_application

select
from business_application application inner join member member_info on member_info.member_id = application.member_id
application.application_status = #{applicationStatus}
order by application.applied_at desc, application.business_application_id desc

select
from business_application application inner join member member_info on member_info.member_id = application.member_id where application.business_application_id = #{applicationId}

select business_application_id AS businessApplicationId, member_id AS memberId, application_status AS applicationStatus from business_application where business_application_id = #{applicationId} for update
mapper.update: update business_application set application_status = 'APPROVED', rejection_reason = null, reviewed_at = now(), reviewed_by = #{adminMemberId} where business_application_id = #{applicationId} and application_status = 'PENDING'

update business_application set application_status = 'REJECTED', rejection_reason = #{rejectionReason}, reviewed_at = now(), reviewed_by = #{adminMemberId} where business_application_id = #{applicationId} and application_status = 'PENDING'
update member set member_role = 'BUSINESS' where member_id = #{memberId} and member_type = 2 and member_role = 'USER' and member_status = 'ACTIVE' and deleted_at is null
